verdict.rationale: The franchise tax page links a public "Look Up Account Status" tool, and the Comptroller's Active Franchise Tax Permit Holders dataset answers keyless queries, so a founder can publicly check entity or registration standing. Status of a specific filing or return appears to sit behind an authenticated eSystems/Webfile session, and the homepage only carries a generic "reports in processing" notice. Missing for 10: public per-filing or application status tracking, documentation of what the account status lookup shows, hands-on corroboration of the lookup tool.
